5204.title: Personal child placement overrides an explicit machine
5204.rootCauseOneLine: Personal-child policy returns parent environment reuse before comparing the requested machine with the parent host.
5204.proposedFix: Reuse only for omitted machine selection or a matching existing host; preserve different-host and new-machine requests for normal placement.
5204.caveats: Server-policy regression repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts; no real cross-OS agent session. Reproduction test and logs are inline to comply with reports repository policy.
